system_name: Triboelectric Electrostatic Bento & Coulomb Surface Potential Shaders

vector_engine.solver: Real-time 2D electrostatic potential V(x,y) and Coulomb gradient field E = -∇V computed across 600 surface nodes
vector_engine.particle_adhesion: Coulomb force F = qE driving 300 airborne dry toner particles along field streamlines
vector_engine.variable_font_axis: OpenType Weight (wght: 350 to 800) and letter-spacing dynamically coupled to surface potential voltage
vector_engine.sound_synthesis: Web Audio API high-voltage corona hiss, toner paper friction, and crisp mechanical capacitor discharge spark snaps
